court-overview: The ramps, cargo and banner mounting frames are present. The source character artwork is replaced by dark banner surfaces.
The port's lower court is much darker than the original at this camera.
west-control: The large Hammond wall display is absent, although the surrounding wall and doorway are present.
The source's red wall appearance is not reproduced. This view alone does not distinguish material tint from lighting.
north-platform: The Distribution Center sign, tower panels and elevated approaches are present.
The original's distant city and cloud backdrop is replaced by the port's simplified sky.
west-cargo: The stacked containers and yellow railings line up with the original.
The foreground panels retain paint variation, but the surrounding walls and cargo are darker and less colourful.
south-overview: The central hanging cylinder and surrounding structural columns are present.
The equipment below the cylinder lacks much of the source's illuminated screen detail and red/cyan lighting.
east-control: The second Hammond wall display is also absent. The doorway and wall panel geometry are present.
The source has blue wall panels and bright local fixtures; the port is more neutral and dimmer.
lower-court: Both stair approaches, foreground cargo and thin overhead zipline ropes are present.
Bright overhead lighting, distant displays and atmospheric light shafts differ substantially from the source.
central-window: The overhead beams, central ramps and equipment stations are present.
Several source screens show Hammond graphics; corresponding port screens are flat blue. The underside lighting is also much darker.
north-closure: A cyan grid-textured blocker crosses the port's hallway. The original shows the hallway panels and a Hammond-marked object farther inside.
This is a deliberately closed room: retain its access restriction while replacing the visible blocker with a suitable surface.
upper-west: The raised walkway, roof dome and tall wall structure are present.
Small rooftop equipment and red warning lights visible in the source are absent; distant city scenery is simplified.
upper-east: The mirrored upper walkway and roof structure are present.
Small rooftop fixtures and the source's city/cloud backdrop remain missing or approximated.
west-banner: The banner support beams are visible in both engines at this angle.
The port's banners have no character artwork and remain substantially darker than the original.

arena-overview: The two large tunnels, cranes, roads and central rock structures are present.
The source has much denser foliage and broad green/purple terrain patches. The port shows more exposed rock and snow. Source banner artwork is absent.
west-tunnel: The Titanfall catwalk and railings are present; they are an intentional addition to the original tube.
The bright ring lights and red colouring on the overhead pipes differ from the source.
west-building: The console housings and large monitor frame are present, but the source's green monitor graphics are missing.
Console surface appearances still differ, and smaller clutter visible in the original is absent.
east-building: The opposite building has the same blank large monitor. Console surfaces and some smaller equipment differ from the original.
The port's red interior lighting is stronger at this camera than in the source.
east-tunnel: The outer tube, support platform, railings and central machinery are visible.
The source's overhead pipes have red paint; the corresponding port pipes are predominantly grey/white. Nearby foliage is also much sparser.
west-tunnel-bend: The port's tunnel walls, red service pipes, catwalk and railings are visible from the raised camera.
R5R produced a black scene at this location at both tested heights. Its cause is unresolved, so this view cannot establish a faithful source/port lighting or geometry difference.
east-tunnel-bend: Both games show the curved tunnel shell, service pipes and fixtures. The added Titanfall catwalk and railings are clearly visible from the raised camera.
The source fixtures are brighter. The port's catwalk changes the interior silhouette, as intended.
central-rocks: The large foreground rocks and nearby truck are present.
The source's dense ground plants and green terrain treatment are missing or approximated. The port's trees also have a visibly different pale/snowy appearance.
west-stairs: The staircase is visible at this fixed camera and matches the main step layout.
This static view does not test the previously reported disappearance when standing on the stairs and turning.
nessie-rocks: The truck, nearby container and road are present. Much of the source's surrounding foliage is absent and the ground treatment differs.
The doll itself is obscured at this angle, so this view does not verify Nessie's detail or support placement.
terrain-seam: The roadway and curb are present, but leaf litter, dirty surface blending and painted markings differ substantially.
The port has a cleaner cracked-road appearance with much less ground foliage at the edge.
